ayahs.translation: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

ayahs.text: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
ayahs.translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

ayahs.text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees
(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn
